argv:
repo=$1
  log=$2
  while true; do
    date -u +"FAST64_REPAIRED_RAMP_SUPERVISOR utc=%FT%TZ" >> "$log"
    "$repo/util/dtc_l1/collect_fast64_repaired_ramp_v1.sh" --collect >> "$log" 2>&1 || printf "RAMP1_COLLECT_NONZERO=%s\n" "$?" >> "$log"
    "$repo/util/dtc_l1/collect_fast64_repaired_ramp2_v1.sh" --collect >> "$log" 2>&1 || printf "RAMP2_COLLECT_NONZERO=%s\n" "$?" >> "$log"
    sleep 120
  done

set -euo pipefail
  fw=$1; gen=$2; log=$3
  summary="$gen/fast64_3_dynamic_base_v1/fast64_3_2DConvolution_base_cap8192_a1_v2.json"
  structural="$gen/fast64_3_dynamic_base_v1/FAST64_3_2DCONVOLUTION_BASE_STRUCTURAL_METRICS_V1.json"
  while ! { test -f "$summary" && test -f "$structural"; }; do
    printf "FAST64_3_V2_AGGREGATION_WAIT utc=%s summary=%s structural=%s\n" "$(date -u +%FT%TZ)" "$(test -f "$summary" && echo yes || echo no)" "$(test -f "$structural" && echo yes || echo no)" >> "$log"
    sleep 120
  done
  for f in fast64_3_base_rows.tsv fast64_3_structural_pressure.tsv fast64_3_live_misses.tsv fast64_3_host_runtime.tsv fast64_3_identity_manifest.tsv; do test ! -e "$gen/$f"; done
  python3 "$fw/util/dtc_l1/collect_fast64_3_base_matrix_v2.py" --output-dir "$gen" >> "$log" 2>&1
  printf "FAST64_3_V2_AGGREGATION_PASS utc=%s\n" "$(date -u +%FT%TZ)" >> "$log"

repo="$1"; log="$2"; while true; do date -u +"FAST64_6_COLLECTOR utc=%FT%TZ" >> "$log"; "$repo/util/dtc_l1/collect_fast64_6_precompute_v1.sh" --collect >> "$log" 2>&1 || printf "FAST64_6_COLLECT_NONZERO=%s\\n" "$?" >> "$log"; sleep 120; done

repo="$1"; log="$2"; while true; do date -u +"FAST64_6_V2_COLLECTOR utc=%FT%TZ" >> "$log"; "$repo/util/dtc_l1/collect_fast64_6_precompute_v2.sh" --collect >> "$log" 2>&1 || printf "FAST64_6_V2_COLLECT_NONZERO=%s\\n" "$?" >> "$log"; sleep 120; done

repo=$1; log=$2; while true; do date -u +"FAST64_6_V3_COLLECTOR utc=%FT%TZ" >> "$log"; "$repo/util/dtc_l1/collect_fast64_6_precompute_v3.sh" --collect >> "$log" 2>&1 || printf "FAST64_6_V3_COLLECT_NONZERO=%s\n" "$?" >> "$log"; sleep 120; done

repo=$1; log=$2; while :; do date -u +%FT%TZ >>"$log"; "$repo/util/dtc_l1/collect_fast64_6_precompute_v10.sh" --collect >>"$log" 2>&1 || printf "collector_nonterminal_or_failure\n" >>"$log"; sleep 120; done

set -euo pipefail
  repo=$1; summary=$2; structural=$3; registry=$4; outdir=$5; log=$6; lock=$7
  exec 9>"$lock"; flock -n 9 || exit 1
  while ! { test -f "$summary" && test -f "$structural"; }; do
    printf "FAST64_3_CORE41_CANDIDATE_WAIT utc=%s summary=%s structural=%s\n" "$(date -u +%FT%TZ)" "$(test -f "$summary" && echo yes || echo no)" "$(test -f "$structural" && echo yes || echo no)" >>"$log"
    sleep 120
  done
  test ! -e "$registry"; test ! -e "$outdir"
  "$repo/util/dtc_l1/prepare_fast64_3_core41_registry_v1.py" --output "$registry" >>"$log" 2>&1
  "$repo/util/dtc_l1/collect_fast64_3_base_matrix_v2.py" --registry "$registry" --output-dir "$outdir" >>"$log" 2>&1
  printf "FAST64_3_CORE41_CANDIDATE_COLLECTOR_PASS utc=%s registry=%s outdir=%s\n" "$(date -u +%FT%TZ)" "$registry" "$outdir" >>"$log"

while tmux has-session -t c2p-v3-priority5 2>/dev/null; do sleep 30; done; python3 "/workspace/worktrees/accel-sim-c2p-addr-observe/scripts/analyze_c2p_confirmation_policy_matrix.py" --root "/workspace/worktrees/accel-sim-c2p-addr-observe/hw_run/c2p-confirmation-policy-v3-cap4-20260823" --case atax,bicg,3mm,c2p-pannotia-pagerank,c2p-pannotia-color-max --csv "/workspace/worktrees/accel-sim-c2p-addr-observe/hw_run/c2p-confirmation-policy-v3-cap4-20260823/priority5_policy_matrix.csv" --markdown "/workspace/worktrees/accel-sim-c2p-addr-observe/hw_run/c2p-confirmation-policy-v3-cap4-20260823/priority5_policy_matrix.md" >"/workspace/worktrees/accel-sim-c2p-addr-observe/hw_run/c2p-confirmation-policy-v3-cap4-20260823/priority5.audit.log" 2>&1

cd /workspace/worktrees/accel-sim-tls-cache && env TLS_P9_APPS=polybench_fdtd2d TLS_P9_MODES=baseline TLS_P9_PLACEMENTS=frozen_hash bash experiments/tls_cache/run_p9_matrix.sh hw_run/tls-cache-p9/fdtd-shards/baseline.frozen_hash > hw_run/tls-cache-p9/fdtd-shards/baseline.frozen_hash/driver.out 2>&1

set -euo pipefail; while tmux has-session -t c2p-l1-16k-rs 2>/dev/null || tmux has-session -t c2p-rs-classification 2>/dev/null; do sleep 60; done; PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 "/workspace/worktrees/accel-sim-c2p-addr-observe/scripts/analyze_c2p_l1_capacity_rs.py" --l1-16-root "/workspace/worktrees/accel-sim-c2p-addr-observe/hw_run/c2p-paper-table-l1-16k-rs-v1-20260824" --l1-64-paper16-csv /workspace/worktrees/accel-sim-c2p-cache/hw_run/c2p-paper16-analysis-final-v7-20260821/paper16_modes.csv --l1-64-extension-csv "/workspace/worktrees/accel-sim-c2p-addr-observe/hw_run/c2p-v100-rs-classification-v1-20260824/extension_rs.csv" --csv "/workspace/worktrees/accel-sim-c2p-addr-observe/hw_run/c2p-paper-table-l1-16k-rs-v1-20260824/l1_capacity_rs_compare.csv" --markdown "/workspace/worktrees/accel-sim-c2p-addr-observe/docs/c2p-cache/c2p_table1_l1_capacity_rs_crosscheck_20260824.md"; echo FINALIZED $(date --iso-8601=seconds)
